message.content: {"rephrased_statement": "Twenty-eight entertainment firms filed a lawsuit against the creators of peer-to-peer software, accusing them of enabling copyright infringement. The Supreme Court of the United States recently listened to oral arguments in this landmark MGM v. Grokster case. The core legal issue is whether software developers can be held responsible for illegal file-sharing. The outcome of this dispute might change how digital content is distributed across the nation."}
